text:
Assistant A gives a valid, well-structured JSON object, with the correct country, capital, and language for each of the three sentences, keyed by a, b, and c. Assistant B misreads the task: it puts the entire sentence into the "country" field instead of extracting the country name. It also outputs three separate JSON objects rather than one valid JSON document, and it doesn't label them a, b, or c. Assistant A is clearly better.

[[A]]
